Chain and splash towers chew through {} where single-target towers fall behind. The denser the group, the bigger the payoff.
Damage numbers flag the matchup: tiny grey means your tower is the wrong type, big gold means it is the perfect counter.
Frost slows and chips, but its damage is tiny, so treat it as a slower. Stack it in front of a {} tower so frozen enemies sit in the kill zone longer.
Heavy armor shrugs off most damage but folds to {}. Check the wave preview for the next armor mix before you spend.
Mix your damage types. A single tower line that all deals the same kind of damage will get walled by the wrong armor.
Plan research around upcoming waves. One node finished before a Ghost surge or an armored boss can flip the fight. Research resets on game restart.
Selling a tower refunds {} of everything you invested, base cost plus all upgrades. Don't hesitate to reshuffle between waves.
The compass shows true map north. When the map is rotated, a small reset button appears next to it. Click that to face north again.
Upgrade costs scale steeply (×1.25 per level). A second tower of a different damage type often beats maxing the first one out.
Watch the route grid in build mode. Towers placed off the corridor will not have line of sight to incoming enemies.
